comparable_budget.starting_repo: Task-specific blank Node 22 module with solve(input) interface.
comparable_budget.tools: Node.js 22, offline editor, local tests, no external packages. Same OS and CPU class for human groups where feasible.
comparable_budget.clock: Wall-clock per task; hard limit 25 min; no pauses unless recorded.
comparable_budget.tests: All groups can inspect the same public acceptance fixtures; scoring tests are immutable.

arms.name: Human only
arms.rule: Human works unaided by generative AI; ordinary editor and Node local tooling allowed.

arms.name: Human + local small model
arms.rule: Human can ask/correct one identified local model; record full checkpoint, quantization, prompts and tools. No cloud model.

arms.name: Human + cloud model
arms.rule: Human can ask/correct one identified cloud model; record version, usage and limits. No secondary models.

arms.name: Bounded model-first
arms.rule: One model gets the task once and can produce one answer without mid-task human corrections. Human selects task, configures environment and records the result; arm is not machine self-direction.

design.block: Text T01-03; Aggregation T04-06; Records T07-09; Structure T10-12.
design.assignment: Before first eligible trial, register a random-seed, blocked task-by-condition rotation and task order in a separate append-only assignment file. Each task occurs in all four conditions across independent rounds or participants; never have the same investigator repeat a memorized task across arms and interpret it as unbiased.
design.calibration: Task difficulty matched only tentatively. Run and document a separate formative calibration without treating calibration observations as confirmatory results.
design.consent: Only investigator-self-tests without recruited participants until appropriate consent and any necessary review are in place.
design.exclusions: Withdrawals, interruptions, crashes, noncompliance and model outages are logged; retain all registered tasks in intention-to-treat summaries and show per-protocol results separately.
